ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Group And Account Reconnaissance Activity Using Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects suspicious reconnaissance command line activity on Windows systems using Net.EXE
Check if the user that executed the commands is suspicious (e.g. service accounts, LOCAL_SYSTEM)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND ((((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ group\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ localgroup\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*domain\\ admins.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ administrator.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ administrateur.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*enterprise\\ admins.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Exchange\\ Trusted\\ Subsystem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remote\\ Desktop\\ Users.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Utilisateurs\\ du\\ Bureau\\ à\\ distance.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Usuarios\\ de\\ escritorio\\ remoto.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/do.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/add.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ accounts\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/do.*")))
